criteria.requirement: Implement confuse.literal.Literal(expected,default=REQUIRED) as a real Template. Require recursive type-and-value equality for scalars, dict keys/values and sequences: True,1,1.0 differ and list differs from tuple. Constructor detaches expected and validates explicit default against it. Conversion raises normal ConfigValueError with view path on mismatch, missing required values retain NotFoundError. Returned mutable values and defaults must be independent copies, without changing legacy Choice or coercive templates.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
